item.title: Palau tourism closes 2025 strong, January arrivals up 13%
item.description: KOROR (Island Times/Pacnews) — The Palau Visitors Authority reported that Palau closed 2025 with solid tourism gains and opened 2026 on an upward trend, welcoming 7,810 visitors in January — a 13% increase from the 6,902 recorded in January 2025. item.description: (Reuters) — Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he expected the war against Iran was "not going to take years," as the conflict widened with Israel attacking Iran-backed Hezbollah targets in Lebanon and Iran hitting Gulf states that host U.S. bases. item.title: Smoke and dye testing for Garapan on March 5
item.description: (Commonwealth Utilities Corporation) — Dye tests and smoke tests will be conducted in Garapan (Bukiki Ave.) on Thursday, March 5, 2026, from 8:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. The purpose of these tests is to identify leaks, breaks, and other connections in CUC’s sewer system. item.title: Amadea cruise guests experience local hospitality, culture
item.description: THE MS Amadea, a premium German cruise ship operated by Phoenix Reisen, received a lively island welcome when it arrived at the Port of Saipan early Tuesday morning. Passengers were greeted by cultural dancers, local vendors, and a street‑market-style reception organized by the Marianas Visitors Authority.
